headline: Nifty fell 1.75% while the *broader market lost less*
subline: Banks dragged the frontline. FIIs bought cash while DIIs sold.
hero_text: The frontline fell harder than the rest. Midcap 150 lost 0.92% and Smallcap 250 lost 0.69%, as FIIs bought and DIIs sold.

why.title: Banks led the slide
why.desc: Private banks and PSU banks both fell over 3%, pulling the index down.

why.title: Fear hit a 21 session high
why.desc: India VIX climbed to the top of its recent range.

why.title: Flows pulled in opposite ways
why.desc: FIIs bought in cash while DIIs sold, and the index still fell.

why.title: No clear cause surfaced
why.desc: No single trigger was named. Declines outnumbered advances 1,997 to 748.

sector_reasons.Realty: Edged up while the tape fell
sector_reasons.PSU Bank: Sold off in step with private lenders
sector_reasons.Private Bank: HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank fell over 3%

bonus_text: FIIs bought Rs 5,672.99 Cr and DIIs sold Rs 2,760.12 Cr. The two pointed opposite ways on a day the index fell.
movers_note_gainers: TCS led at 3.53%. TechM and HCLTech made it three IT names in the top four.
movers_note_losers: Tata Steel sank 8.43%. Axis Bank, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank each lost over 3%.
watch_text: Wednesday reopens after the holiday. Nifty closed between the 25,300 and 25,400 OI strikes. US GDP and PCE follow.
lessons: Banks outweighed everything. Private and PSU banks fell together while IT rose against them.
Foreign cash did not cap the fall. DIIs sold, and decliners beat advancers by about 2.7 to 1.
Fear sat at the top of its 21 session range, so the fall was not shrugged off.
IT moved against the tape. TCS led the Nifty gainers while Tata Steel led the losers.
alert_text: Wednesday 25 November reopens after Tuesday's holiday. US Core PCE and GDP data land at 23:00 IST.
cta_headline: Index down, IT up. *Market shuts Tuesday*.
cta_sub: Tuesday 24 Nov is an NSE holiday. Next bell is Wednesday 25 November.
next_text: Wednesday 25 November is the next session. Tuesday is an NSE holiday. US Core PCE and GDP follow at 23:00 IST.
caption_a:
Nifty fell 1.75% to 25,349.65 but IT rose 1.69%.
Bank Nifty dropped 3.17%. Breadth ran 748 up to 1,997 down.
FIIs bought Rs 5,672.99 Cr while DIIs sold Rs 2,760.12 Cr.
Watch: Wednesday 25 November reopens after the Tuesday holiday.
